Source: Faith and Fire, Derangements

In highly traumatic situations, the character sometimes forgets who or even what he is - this typically occurs when he comes face-to-face with his vampiric condition. He might forget a single situation, or everything about his identity including his true nature, even forgetting Abilities or Disciplines and being surprised to find he can do things he thought were beyond him.

Trigger/Effect: When events or situations that might remind him of his lost memories present themselves, those memories may return, sometimes violently and sending the character into frenzy.
